query: What should I select for SG Arrival Card (SGAC) if I have an In-Principle Approval (IPA) issued by MOM or ICA?
reference_answer: A holder of an In-Principle Approval (IPA) issued by ICA/MOM will need to submit the arrival information and the health declaration as a foreign visitor via the SG Arrival Card e-Service.
answer: If you have an In-Principle Approval (IPA) issued by either the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) or Immigration & Border Protection (ICA), you should select "Yes" for the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) field when applying. [Document 1]
